settings.title: Settings
settings.feedbackDesc: Report bugs or suggest improvements. App version and device ID are attached automatically to help us investigate.

settings.engineDesc: Choose which engine runs the assistant. Takes effect on the next conversation.
settings.modelDesc: Choose a preset or add a custom model. API connection maps to ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN in the default config.
settings.modelApiDesc: Built-in mode uses the app gateway. Custom mode sets an Anthropic-compatible base URL and key for all built-in presets.
settings.modelApiKeyHint: Saved key: {hint} (leave blank to keep unchanged)
settings.modelCustomDesc: Add providers such as Qwen or GLM. Configure API plus Haiku/Sonnet/Opus tiers; blanks inherit the main model or global API above.

settings.searchDesc: Search engine for web lookups. Applies to new chats after switching.
settings.searxngHint: Custom SearXNG is preferred when set; otherwise built-in public instances are tried.
settings.connectorsDesc: Authorize external capabilities such as mail, OA, and web systems. Secrets stay in the local main process; the assistant can only act through controlled connectors.

settings.connectors.label: Display name
settings.connectors.oauthHint: OAuth requires a desktop app on the provider platform. Lily generates the local callback address automatically. Saved providers are configured first, then become connected after the authorization flow.
settings.connectors.empty: No accounts yet. After adding one, mail skills can read and draft through the controlled connector.
settings.skillsDesc: Manage assistant skills. Skill packages are delivered by the service like resource packs and synced periodically; the built-in catalog is only a fallback. Changes apply to new chats.
settings.skillsSearchPlaceholder: Search skills by name or description…
settings.appsDesc: Browse workspace apps, templates, dashboards, and connectors published by the service. Apps are exported from workspaces; runtime and skill dependencies appear on each card.

permission.plan.label: Plan
permission.plan.desc: Read-only: analyze the workspace and propose a plan without changing files or running commands.
permission.ask.label: Ask
permission.ask.desc: Works automatically inside this workspace; only confirms risky commands (delete/push/publish) and changes outside the workspace. Reading and research stay automatic.

permission.full.desc: Full autonomy: edits files and runs commands without asking; still confirms a few irreversible disasters (wiping root/home, formatting disks). Use only in trusted workspaces.
